calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as total_lines_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT frl.sales_line_id) as lines_returned,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.quantity_returned), 0) as units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.quantity_returned), 0) as units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(frl.quantity_returned), 0) / SUM(fsl.quantity), 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id

  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ds.format

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  'Sales with missing store' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE fsl.store_key IS NULL
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Sales with negative qty' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE fsl.quantity < 0
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Returns with negative qty' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_return_line frl
WHERE frl.quantity_returned < 0
  AND frl.sales_line_id IN (
    SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line fsl
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
    WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
  )
